process_candidate: Standard four-layer, 1 oz outer / 2 oz inner, 1.6 mm, ENIG. 6 mil track/space, 0.127 mm min annular ring, 0.24 mm min drill. Chosen 2026-09-15 because the TI land patterns for U1/U3/U5 (0.200-0.220 mm pad gaps) cannot meet any 0.254 mm spacing rule, which 2 oz outer copper forces.
